competitors.name: MadeByShape
competitors.positioning: Independent creative web design, branding, and digital development agency for startups, established brands, and global companies.
competitors.pricing_transparency: Low — No public pricing tiers or estimates; requires enquiry/quote form.
competitors.ui_ux_style: High-end editorial, clean typography, whitespace-heavy, case study visual previews.

technical_seo.cwv_performance: Mobile ~65-75; heavy video/asset payloads slow mobile TTFB and LCP.
technical_seo.direct_answer_readiness: Moderate; primarily portfolio-led rather than answer-engine structured.

strengths: 14+ years of brand authority and awards (Awwwards, CSSDA)
Verified Craft CMS and Shopify partner badges
Comprehensive visual case studies with high-profile clients
weaknesses: Zero pricing transparency (clients have no idea of cost without booking calls)
Traditional slow agency turnaround (months, not days)
Heavy reliance on traditional PHP/Craft CMS rather than modern sub-second Next.js SSR/SSG architecture
No interactive project estimation or self-serve discovery tools

competitors.name: Lightflows
competitors.positioning: Award-winning digital product and web development agency blending emerging tech, AI, and human-centred UX.
services: Custom Web Design & High-Performance Web Development
competitors.pricing_transparency: Low — High enterprise agency rates (£10,000+ minimum project budget).
competitors.ui_ux_style: Dark mode modern tech studio aesthetic, sleek micro-interactions, isometric product mockups.

technical_seo.cwv_performance: Mobile ~70; good desktop, but heavy scripts impact mobile TBT.
technical_seo.direct_answer_readiness: Good for high-level digital product queries, weak on small-to-mid commercial pricing.

strengths: ISO accreditation and BIMA member status
Strong focus on complex web apps and platform engineering
weaknesses: Out of reach for startups and growing SMEs (£10k–£50k price barrier)
Complex procurement and long discovery timelines
Clients do not get direct access to engineers (multi-layered project manager hierarchy)
Forced monthly retainers for ongoing support

competitors.name: Propeller
competitors.positioning: Full-service digital agency specializing in luxury, lifestyle, hospitality, and e-commerce websites.
competitors.ui_ux_style: High-fashion luxury aesthetic, large hero imagery, smooth parallax scroll, serif typography.

technical_seo.cwv_performance: Mobile ~55-65; large high-res imagery creates heavy LCP on mobile networks.

strengths: Exquisite creative direction and visual design
weaknesses: Extreme price barrier for 95% of businesses
Very heavy page weights harming mobile Core Web Vitals
Lengthy corporate contracts and high monthly retainers
Little focus on sub-second technical architecture

competitors.name: KOTA
competitors.positioning: Creative digital agency specializing in bespoke branding, web design, and digital experiences.
competitors.pricing_transparency: Low — Standard agency quote model starting at £8,000–£15,000.
competitors.ui_ux_style: Vibrant, avant-garde creative agency aesthetic, experimental typography, dynamic cursor effects.

technical_seo.cwv_performance: Mobile ~60; heavy canvas animations and custom JavaScript libraries.
technical_seo.direct_answer_readiness: Low; focuses entirely on visual flair over structured informative content.

strengths: Outstanding artistic and creative animation skills
Award-winning showcase on CSS Design Awards and Awwwards
weaknesses: Style over performance: animation scripts harm Core Web Vitals and mobile UX
No transparent pricing or instant project scoping
Relies heavily on traditional WordPress/Webflow rather than modern full-stack web applications
High barrier to entry for pragmatic commercial businesses

competitors.name: Chilliapple
competitors.positioning: Bespoke web development and custom software engineering company helping businesses scale.
competitors.pricing_transparency: Moderate — Hourly rate ranges published (£35–£65/hr), but project costs remain gated behind sales calls.
competitors.ui_ux_style: Corporate IT services style, structured blue/orange corporate color palette, feature-driven layouts.

technical_seo.cwv_performance: Mobile ~75; respectable but lacks edge-cached modern SSR/SSG.
technical_seo.direct_answer_readiness: Moderate; good service descriptions, but lacks interactive tooling and AI-first answer blocks.

strengths: Broad technology capabilities across legacy and modern platforms
Affordable hourly pricing compared to Mayfair London agencies
Solid UK client base across multiple commercial sectors
weaknesses: Corporate, dated visual design aesthetic
Often relies on offshore developer teams, diluting direct senior engineering communication
No live working interactive proof tools on site
Complex scopes with frequent change-order cost escalations
